visual.general_description: Grayscale axial CT slice of the neck with the larynx and air lumen centrally.
visual.detailed_description: Grayscale axial computed tomography slice through the neck. The outer skin contour is oval with a thin dark surrounding border. In the centre front is the larynx with bright, dense curved cartilage margins and a black, roughly triangular air-filled lumen. Behind it a bright rounded vertebral body and bony posterior elements are seen, flanked by paired soft-tissue muscle masses and darker fat planes. Black rectangular blocks cover areas along the top edge. Near the bottom edge partly legible scanner overlay text includes the word AVERAGE with short numeric strings and a short horizontal scale bar; the overlay text is only partly legible. No panel letters or arrows are visible. No date is legible.
